yaw_semantics: boot-relative gyroscope-integrated estimate; drift-prone; not absolute heading
change_reason: M11.2d validated pose configuration. Complementary alpha changed from 0.98 to 0.95 under attitude-complementary-v2 while the 100 ms / 10 Hz pose publish target remained unchanged. Stationary hardware validation showed RollStd=0.020 deg, PitchStd=0.022 deg, RollP2P=0.099 deg, and PitchP2P=0.126 deg. The primary confirmed cadence bottleneck was verbose R1_DECISION UART logging rather than transport freshness: disabling that Serial output while preserving MQTT telemetry improved the measured 30 s effective pose rate from 7.13 Hz to 9.74 Hz and reduced >=200 ms gaps from 62 to 5. Validated firmware: 0.3.5-r1. No claim is made that alpha alone caused the responsiveness improvement.
